key_findings: Intravesical CBD (100 mg/kg) improved bladder function, reduced pain behavior and bladder inflammation/fibrosis in CYP-induced IC/BPS rats.
CBD reduced TNF-α, COX2, IL-6, TRPV1 and TLR4/MyD88/pNF-κB, and lowered Bax/Bcl-xL and caspase-3 in rat bladder and SV-HUC-1 cells.
